doc.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Trombone influences
summary: He names Miff Mole, Bill Rank, Bix, Watrous and Carl Fontana as influences.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Who are you listening to mostly?

You know I started listening to one guy called Miff Mole, was an early trombone player, Bill Rank, early Bix. And people like that. And then eventually as I got a little older, especially as I got into the Navy and guys were listening to Watrous and Carl Fontana and people, I later worked with all of them. And I started — but I’m proud to say I really had the roots. I got criticized a little for maybe playing a little too modern in that genre. But you don’t know what to do.

I was going to ask you about that. Because the list people that you’ve played with, if you go from Dizzy Gillespie to Al Hirt, do you try to tailor your playing to better match with what those people are doing?
